description: Canonical pinned toolchain manifest for OpenCode repair and CI. Production jobs never resolve these tools from an unauthenticated 'latest' lookup; the daily toolchain-update workflow proposes manifest bumps as reviewable PRs, and changed manifest values naturally generate new cache generations.

windows.notes: Platform-specific install steps may differ, but manifest fields, key derivation inputs, and the setup-toolchain output contract are identical across macOS, Linux, and Windows.
